picks.editorial_note: A $53M ARPA-H award is one of the largest single funding events of the week, and pairing generative AI compound discovery with agricultural/environmental safety signals a growing federal appetite for AI-driven chemistry at scale.
picks.title: MIT-led team receives funding to develop next-generation alternatives to modern weed killers

picks.editorial_note: WorldParticle's single model spanning sand, fluids, and protein folding is a genuine generalization leap for physical simulation, with potential ripple effects across materials science, biology, and robotics.
picks.title: A single AI model simulates the behavior of many substances, from sliding sand to folding proteins

picks.editorial_note: An independent AI-based confirmation of the iconic M87 black hole image, published in Nature, strengthens confidence in one of astronomy's landmark results and showcases AI's growing role in validating fundamental science.
picks.title: New CSIRO technique confirms iconic black hole image

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL and CMU's 'Workspace Models' tackle a core bottleneck in robot learning—efficient memory of past observations—with direct implications for deploying capable robots outside tightly controlled settings.
picks.title: A new form of memory helps robots learn complex skills

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's MoU with humanoid robotics firm Unitree, anchored to a planned joint laboratory, marks a concrete academia-industry bet on embodied AI that could accelerate real-world robotics deployment in Asia.
picks.title: HKUST and Unitree Sign MoU to Advance Embodied AI and Robotics Collaboration
picks.university: Hong Kong Univ. of Science and Technology

picks.editorial_note: The Atos-Inria partnership targets sovereign industrial AI across agentic systems, robotics, and cybersecurity, reflecting Europe's push to translate public research into strategically independent industrial capability.
picks.title: Atos and Inria enter into a strategic partnership to accelerate the transfer of research into sovereign industrial applications

picks.editorial_note: SMU's $4.2M NIST-backed Digital Twin Technology Lab links AI and HPC directly to semiconductor manufacturing workforce needs, a priority area for U.S. industrial policy.
picks.title: SMU awarded $4.2 million to advance AI-driven manufacturing and workforce training

picks.editorial_note: Allegations tying Nvidia's CEO to a suspected espionage case raise serious national-security questions about the company at the center of the global AI hardware supply chain, with potential policy ramifications.
picks.title: Nvidia CEO’s scandal raises questions about US national security

picks.editorial_note: ZEBRA-Prop's lightweight language-model approach to predicting material properties lowers the computational barrier to AI-accelerated materials discovery, a capability with broad downstream scientific utility.
